instrument: Tulare County data center moratorium extension
summary: Supervisors unanimously extended the moratorium on new data centers in unincorporated areas by 10 months and 15 days.

source.citation: Strisker Data Centers Daily Notes, Sept 28, 2026 (digest)

notes: Earlier version said 10 months. Same meeting: separate 3-2 vote on a formal position opposing most data center development in the county (see ca-tulare-county-opposition-position).
